definitions.full: H6424. palas [ מָּלַס ] verb Pi`el denominative weigh, make level (Phoenician פלס Pi`el make level (?) in proper names); — Imperfect 3masculine singular יְפַלֵּס Psa 78:20 ; 2 masculine plural תְּפַלֵּס֑וּן 58:3 (see below), etc.; Imperative masculine singular מַּלֵּס Prov 4:26 ; Participle מְפַלֵּס 5:11 ; — 1 weign out תּפי יְדֵיכֶם חֲמַס Psa 58:3 (figurative; but read perhaps תְּפַלֵּסְנָה יְדֵיכֶם תָמָס violence do your hands weigh out , so ᵑ7 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Bae Kau We). 2 make level , smooth (compare Gerber 32 ), with accusative of path (figurative), מַעְגָּל Prov 4:26 ; 5:21 ; Isa 26:7 , נָתִּיב Psa 78:50 , אֹרַח Prov 5:6 .
